say:1:1322105001:1.text: Last night, I went to Whiteridge Temple to pray and unintentionally heard townsfolk requesting help from the acolytes.
say:1:1322105001:1.source_cn: 昨天晚上我去白山修道院祷告，无意中听到有镇民来向修士求助。

choice_prompt:2:1322105001.text: Last night, I went to Whiteridge Temple to pray and unintentionally heard townsfolk requesting help from the acolytes.
choice_prompt:2:1322105001.source_cn: 昨天晚上我去白山修道院祷告，无意中听到有镇民来向修士求助。

say:3:1322105002:1.text: Yes, being in the temple makes me feel closer to the goddess. Don't worry, though—I go quietly, and no one ever notices me.
say:3:1322105002:1.source_cn: 嗯……在修道院里，我感觉能更靠近女神。别担心，我都是悄...

say:4:1322105005:1.text: Since the Hierophant fell and most of the acolytes perished, there's been no one left to manage the temple. Everything's in disarray, and the remaining acolytes are too overwhelmed to help the townsfolk right now.
say:4:1322105005:1.source_cn: 可自从大主教恶堕，修士修女死亡，修道院就无人管理。现在...

say:5:1322105006:1.text: Can you go to the temple and take a look? Maybe there is something that you can help with.
say:5:1322105006:1.source_cn: 你们能去修道院看看吗？如果可以的话，希望你们能帮帮他们。

say:6:1322105007:1.text: Yes, of course! We'll gladly help anyone in need.
say:6:1322105007:1.source_cn: 当然啦，这是我们说好的，我们现在就去！

choice:2:0:1.text: You still pray at the temple?
choice:2:0:1.male: You still pray at the temple?
choice:2:0:1.female: You still pray at the temple?

say:8:1322105003:1.text: Yes, even though the temple has been damaged by evil forces, its spirit remains unbroken. The Divine Light will one day restore it to its former glory.
say:8:1322105003:1.source_cn: 我明白……那座教堂被邪恶的力量毁得不成样子，但它的本质...

say:9:1322105004:1.text: I have been a follower of Dura since I was a child. Even if I am a Graveborn now, my faith has not changed.
say:9:1322105004:1.source_cn: 我从小就是女神的信徒，即使成为了亡灵，我也不会改变我的信仰。

say:0:1322107001:0.text: What happened? The acolyte seems to be in trouble...
say:0:1322107001:0.source_cn: 发生了什么？那位修士似乎很为难……

say:1:1322108001:0.text: *Sigh*... Yes, I hear you. I want to help...
say:1:1322108001:0.source_cn: 唉……我明白，我也很想帮忙……

say:2:1322108002:0.text: I don't know what's happening! The undead have been wandering around the lake area! Many people in Cedartown have been attacked!
say:2:1322108002:0.source_cn: 不知道怎么回事，这段时间活死人总是从湖区跑出来游荡，雪...

say:3:1322108003:0.text: Dura above, Ogden! You're an acolyte of Whiteridge! Organize your men and cleanse the land of these undead!
say:3:1322108003:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，奥格列，你可是白山的修士！快点组织人手，净化...

say:4:1322108004:0.text: We are short on manpower right now... *Sigh*... Alright, I'll find a way. Just be patient.
say:4:1322108004:0.source_cn: 我……我们最近人手真的很缺乏……唉，好吧，我会想办法的。

say:7:1322108005:0.text: Please, Dura... Tell me what to do...

say:9:1322108007:0.text: Are you also here to seek the temple's help? Apologies, but we're short on manpower... Oh! It's you!
say:9:1322108007:0.source_cn: 你们几位也是来寻求修道院的帮助吗？实在抱歉，我们人手缺...

say:11:1322108009:1.text: When the Hierophant was holding the ritual, you saved me!
say:11:1322108009:1.source_cn: 大主教举行邪恶献祭的时候，是你们救了我！

choice_prompt:12:1322108009.text: When the Hierophant was holding the ritual, you saved me!
choice_prompt:12:1322108009.source_cn: 大主教举行邪恶献祭的时候，是你们救了我！

say:13:1322108010:1.text: Dura above, the goddess must've sent you to save me!
say:13:1322108010:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，您一定是女神派来拯救我们的使者！

say:14:1322108013:0.text: If you hadn't intervened, Brother Maxim and I would've been transformed into Hypofiends by the corrupted Hierophant. I never imagined the Hypogean influence could reach the heart of Whiteridge.
say:14:1322108013:0.source_cn: 要不是你们，我和马克西姆兄弟一定会和其他人一样，被恶堕...

say:15:1322108014:0.text: Sadly, only Brother Maxim and I remain in the temple. The Divinum Centrum sent a group of acolytes from nearby to help, but it's still nowhere near enough.
say:15:1322108014:0.source_cn: 唉，修道院只剩下我和马克西姆兄弟，就算圣堂紧急抽调了一...

say:16:1322108015:0.text: Too many people have perished. Simply purifying the dead and preparing funerals is pushing us to the brink. And then there's the task of comforting the populace and maintaining their faith in Whiteridge.
say:16:1322108015:0.source_cn: 太多的人死去，光是为死者进行净化和筹备葬礼，我们就快要...

say:17:1322108016:0.text: Yes, this is the time when manpower can really make a difference. No wonder you seemed so overwhelmed earlier...
say:17:1322108016:0.source_cn: 的确，现在正是需要人的时候，怪不得刚才你一副为难的样子……

say:18:1322108017:0.text: Yes. The news is that St. Valesa's Temple has no acolytes to protect it, and without guards at the lake, the undead have wandered out and started causing harm.
say:18:1322108017:0.source_cn: 是啊，圣瓦勒沙教堂少了住堂的圣职者，没人看守湖区出口，...

say:19:1322108018:0.text: Worse still... the priests, exorcisers, and experienced acolytes were all lost in the sacrificial ritual. Those of us left don't know how to deal with the undead.
say:19:1322108018:0.source_cn: 而且……高阶的修士修女几乎都死在邪恶的献祭仪式里了，我...

choice_prompt:20:1322108018.text: Worse still... the priests, exorcisers, and experienced acolytes were all lost in the sacrificial ritual. Those of us left don't know how to deal with the undead.
choice_prompt:20:1322108018.source_cn: 而且……高阶的修士修女几乎都死在邪恶的献祭仪式里了，我们剩下的人根本拦不住那些活死人！

say:21:1322108019:0.text: You would help us? Praise the goddess! Whiteridge Temple will remember your deeds.
say:21:1322108019:0.source_cn: 噢，真的吗？！赞美女神！白山修道院会铭记您的恩典。
say:21:1322108019:0.male: You would help us? Praise the goddess! Whiteridge Temple will remember your deeds.
say:21:1322108019:0.female: You would help us? Praise the goddess! Whiteridge Temple will remember your deeds.

say:22:1322108020:0.text: Please head to <style="highlight">St. Valesa's Temple</style>. If you can <style="highlight">eliminate the undead threat</style>, the townsfolk will finally be able to breathe easy.
say:22:1322108020:0.male: Please head to <style="highlight">St. Valesa's Temple</style>. If you can <style="highlight">eliminate the undead threat</style>, the townsfolk will finally be able to breathe easy.
say:22:1322108020:0.female: Please head to <style="highlight">St. Valesa's Temple</style>. If you can <style="highlight">eliminate the undead threat</style>, the townsfolk will finally be able to breathe easy.

choice:20:0:1.text: Looks like it's up to us.
choice:20:0:1.male: Looks like it's up to us.
choice:20:0:1.female: Looks like it's up to us.

choice:20:1:2.text: It's time for me to flex my magical muscles.
choice:20:1:2.male: It's time for me to flex my magical muscles.
choice:20:1:2.female: It's time for me to flex my magical muscles.

choice:12:0:1.text: Oh, that was you! I almost forgot.
choice:12:0:1.male: Oh, that was you! I almost forgot.
choice:12:0:1.female: Oh, that was you! I almost forgot.

say:24:1322108011:1.text: Yes, the goddess was looking down on us that day. Praise be to Dura.
say:24:1322108011:1.source_cn: 果然，女神是关注着我们的！赞美女神，至圣至福！

say:25:1322108012:1.text: Yes, you must be talking about Brother Maxim. He wanted to thank you also.
say:25:1322108012:1.source_cn: 是的，马克西姆兄弟也一直很想向你们道谢。

choice:12:2:3.source_cn: 我记得我们救了两个修士？

say:0:1322109001:0.text: Since the Hypogean ritual, no one's been guarding St. Valesa's Temple.
say:0:1322109001:0.source_cn: 从献祭仪式之后，圣瓦勒沙教堂就没有人看守了。

say:1:1322109002:0.text: No wonder all the undead started roaming around.
say:1:1322109002:0.source_cn: 怪不得活死人会从这里跑出来。

say:0:1322111001:0.text: All the undead have been defeated. Acolyte Ogden can rest easy now.
say:0:1322111001:0.source_cn: 活死人被击退了，这下奥格列修士可以放心了。

say:1:1322111002:0.source_cn: 我们回去跟他说一声吧！

say:1:1322112001:0.text: You've returned. How are things at St. Valesa's Temple?
say:1:1322112001:0.source_cn: 你们回来了！圣瓦勒沙教堂那里如何了？

choice_prompt:2:1322112001.text: You've returned. How are things at St. Valesa's Temple?
choice_prompt:2:1322112001.source_cn: 你们回来了！圣金嘉教堂那里如何了？

say:4:1322112003:0.text: Don't worry. We managed to defeat them. St. Valesa's Temple should be safe now.
say:4:1322112003:0.source_cn: 我们驱逐了那些活死人，现在圣瓦勒沙教堂应该很安全。

say:5:1322112005:1.text: Oh, bless Dura! You all have my gratitude. You were indeed sent by the goddess.
say:5:1322112005:1.source_cn: 噢，艾雅保佑！实在是太感谢了，你们果然是女神派来的使者！

say:6:1322112006:1.text: Actually, it was Carolina who sent us. She noticed the temple was understaffed and asked us to come help out...
say:6:1322112006:1.source_cn: 其实是卡列琳娜发觉修道院人手不足，请我们来帮忙的……

say:7:1322112007:1.text: Carolina? I apologize; I don't recall her, but she must be a pious and caring individual. May Dura shine her blessings upon her!
say:7:1322112007:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜？原谅我，我实在记不得所有镇民的名字，但她一定...

say:8:1322112008:1.text: Many things are beyond our capacity right now, but the Divinum Centrum will send more aid and support. We'll do our best to uphold the temple's daily duties until then.
say:8:1322112008:1.source_cn: 有许多事情我们现在没有力量去做，但圣堂一定会再派更多人...

say:9:1322112009:1.text: In any case, thank you for all you've done.
say:9:1322112009:1.source_cn: 无论如何，再次感谢你们无私的帮助。

choice:2:0:1.text: Not good. The undead are numerous.
choice:2:0:1.male: Not good. The undead are numerous.
choice:2:0:1.female: Not good. The undead are numerous.

say:11:1322112004:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，我们把活死人都驱赶走了！

choice:2:1:2.text: Don't worry. Everything is fine now.
choice:2:1:2.male: Don't worry. Everything is fine now.
choice:2:1:2.female: Don't worry. Everything is fine now.

say:1:1322113001:1.text: You've returned. How are things at the temple?
say:1:1322113001:1.source_cn: 你们回来了，修道院的情况怎么样？

choice_prompt:2:1322113001.text: You've returned. How are things at the temple?
choice_prompt:2:1322113001.source_cn: 你们回来了，修道院的情况怎么样？

say:3:1322113002:1.text: Ah, too many funerals and too few hands to manage them... I can only hope the Divinum Centrum will send more help to the temple quickly.
say:3:1322113002:1.source_cn: 太多葬礼导致人手不足……只希望圣堂能尽快派更多的人来。

say:4:1322113003:1.text: Oh, it would be so much better if the temple had more experienced members here. Ordinary acolytes just don't know how to handle the undead.
say:4:1322113003:1.source_cn: 唉，要是圣堂能多派一些高阶圣职者就更好了，这些活死人根...

say:5:1322113004:1.text: I'm still worried. Even if the new acolytes and priests arrive and stop the undead from hurting people, the root problem will still remain.
say:5:1322113004:1.source_cn: 我还是很担心。即便新的圣职者到来之后，能够制止活死人出...

say:6:1322113005:1.text: The undead aren't easily destroyed. They can rise again and wreak havoc unless they're completely cleansed. Only then can the problem truly be solved.
say:6:1322113005:1.source_cn: 活死人无法轻易被杀死，他们会一次又一次复生。除非能让他...

say:7:1322113006:1.text: I've spent years trying to find a way to bring peace to the undead, but I'm no closer to a solution than when I started.
say:7:1322113006:1.source_cn: 这么多年来，我一直在努力寻找能够让活死人彻底安息的方法...

choice_prompt:8:1322113006.text: I've spent years trying to find a way to bring peace to the undead, but I'm no closer to a solution than when I started.
choice_prompt:8:1322113006.source_cn: 这么多年来，我一直在努力寻找能够让活死人彻底安息的方法，只是……我现在依旧没有什么头绪。

say:9:1322113007:1.text: Hierophant Novik attempted to purify the undead many years ago, but it didn't work. The Divine Light could defeat them, but it could not prevent them from rising again.
say:9:1322113007:1.source_cn: 很多年前，诺维茨基大主教曾尝试过净化活死人，但失败了…...

say:10:1322113010:1.text: These undead were heroes who fought against the Hypogeans. Their current state is heartbreaking... I hope they can rest in peace, honored as the warriors they once were.
say:10:1322113010:1.source_cn: 这些活死人曾经是对抗恶魔的英雄，可他们如今的样子让我觉...

say:11:1322113011:1.text: Don't be sad, Carolina. If we work together, we'll definitely find a way.
say:11:1322113011:1.source_cn: 卡列琳娜，别难过，我们一起努力，一定可以找到方法的。

say:12:1322113012:1.text: Thank you all. May Dura bestow upon you strength and wisdom.
say:12:1322113012:1.source_cn: 谢谢你们……愿艾雅赐予你们智慧和力量。

say:13:1322113013:1.text: Would you accompany me to Whiteridge Temple in a few days?
say:13:1322113013:1.source_cn: 对了，过几天你们可以陪我去一趟白山修道院吗？

say:14:1322113014:1.text: Are you going there to pray? You could pray at home. It may be a bit inconvenient for you there...
say:14:1322113014:1.source_cn: 你要去祈祷？可是……那里对你来说还是有些不方便，在家里...

say:15:1322113015:1.text: Many people have unfortunately passed away from the Hypogean incident. Most of them were innocent, ordinary people.
say:15:1322113015:1.source_cn: 这次的恶魔事件里有很多人不幸离世，大部分都是些无辜的普...

say:16:1322113016:1.text: I hope they can rest peacefully and dwell forever in Dura's kingdom. I feel compelled to go to the temple and offer my prayers and wishes for the deceased.
say:16:1322113016:1.source_cn: 我希望他们能够安息，能够回归艾雅女神的国度，所以我想前...

choice_prompt:17:1322113016.text: I hope they can rest peacefully and dwell forever in Dura's kingdom. I feel compelled to go to the temple and offer my prayers and wishes for the deceased.
choice_prompt:17:1322113016.source_cn: 我希望他们能够安息，能够回归艾雅女神的国度，所以我想前往女神的修道院里，在神圣的教堂中向逝者献上我的祷告和祝愿。

say:18:1322113017:1.text: The temple will hold a funeral for the deceased in a few days. I'll see you then, and thank you for everything.
say:18:1322113017:1.source_cn: 过几天修道院会为逝者们举行一场葬礼，到时候我们再见吧，...

choice:17:1:2.text: I'll be worried if you go there alone.
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 好吧……实在不放心你一个人
choice:17:1:2.male: I'll be worried if you go there alone.
choice:17:1:2.female: I'll be worried if you go there alone.

choice:8:0:1.text: How about using the Divine Light?
choice:8:0:1.male: How about using the Divine Light?
choice:8:0:1.female: How about using the Divine Light?

say:20:1322113008:1.text: The undead hunter of the Wilder clan? I've observed him using the Divine Light to subdue the undead. It might be connected to his Wilder powers, but I'm not entirely certain.
say:20:1322113008:1.source_cn: 你是说那位绿裔的亡灵猎人？我曾远远地看到过他出手制服活...

say:21:1322113009:1.text: While his power can greatly slow the undead's resurrection, it still can't fully destroy them.
say:21:1322113009:1.source_cn: 他的力量能够大幅抑制活死人复活的速度，但无法彻底地杀死...

choice:8:2:3.text: I need to check my books...
choice:8:2:3.male: I need to check my books...
choice:8:2:3.female: I need to check my books...

choice:2:1:2.text: We temporarily dealt with the undead issue.
choice:2:1:2.male: We temporarily dealt with the undead issue.
choice:2:1:2.female: We temporarily dealt with the undead issue.
